I've had great success with simple common sense interventions. Here are some ideas that might help. Some of them are going to sound silly but all of the following have given me very significant results:

  • How's your vitamin D status? My bones and teeth were deteriorating until I started taking vitamin D, magnesium and vitamin K2. My policy for supplements in general is to use them to guarantee that you're getting some amount of nutrients, with the majority coming from diet; for example, I take 200mg of magnesium and try to get the rest from food.

  • Taurine is a very safe nutritional supplement that has numerous benefits, one of which is reducing that twisting feeling when you have core muscle spasms. I spent some time paralyzed due to core muscle deterioration a few years back and owe my recovery to it. As an unrelated benefit, taurine protects the heart, liver and brain in case of stroke even if administered after the stroke; it also treats fatty liver and congestive heart failure (in fact it was used by doctors as treatments for these things before the medical industry went to shit).

  • Try lying down on your back on the floor. If it's uncomfortable, then your body is misaligned. Lying down on a hard surface realigns your body. I had trouble breathing because of a severe shoulder and chest injury until I started doing this every morning. They make you do this if you have a herniated/fragmented disc or get into an accident and injure your spine, btw. There's no reason why people shouldn't do this for lesser injuries.

  • Use your thumbs to guide your shoulders back into place. Rotate your shoulders back until the protruding part (scapula) stops sticking out of your back. The top of your shoulder should move back and down a bit, and the scapula should move forward. This fixed my gastroparesis (yes I have/had tons of issues) that my doctors couldn't figure out. Turns out it was due to vagus nerve compression.

  • Having digestive issues makes everything worse because it burdens your body. A lot of blood gets sent into the digestive tract when digestion isn't working well so the rest of your body gets weak and healing is impaired. Consider this if you feel unwell in general. Several safe, easy and effective interventions are available depending on the exact problem.
